Docs·Reference

Files in the folder

What the files and folders inside the MeshOptimiser folder are for, which ones you use, and which ones to leave alone.

You only ever need to double-click one file: the launcher for your system. The rest is the app itself.

The ones you use

start.bat
The launcher for Windows. Double-click it to start the app.
start.command
The launcher for macOS.
start_hidden.vbs
Windows: starts the app like start.bat, without showing the launcher window.
step2glb.bat, step2glb.command
Convert a STEP file that you drag onto them, without opening the viewer.
test-converter.bat, test-converter.command
Run the converter on a STEP file that you drag onto them and show everything it prints. Useful when a conversion fails and you want to see why.
README.txt
A short quick start, in plain text.

Folders the app creates

.venv
The app’s own Python environment, created on the first run. It can take up to about 2 GB. It is safe to delete: the launcher builds it again, which takes a few minutes. On macOS the folder is hidden in Finder, because its name starts with a dot.
inbox
Where STEP files are converted. The finished GLB files stay here.

The inbox folder is not emptied automatically, so it grows with every conversion. With the app closed, you can delete the files in it that you no longer need.

The app itself

serve.py
The small local server. It hands the app’s pages to your browser and starts the converter when you drop a STEP file.
step2glb.py
The converter from STEP to GLB.
index.html, app-v2.js
The viewer: the page and its program.
holefill.js
The hole filler behind Fill holes.
mesh-worker.js
A background worker for Fill holes and Decimate, so the window stays usable while they run.
cloner.js
A cloner that makes linear, grid and radial arrays of a part.
vendor
The libraries the viewer needs, bundled so that it starts without the internet.
assets
The app’s icons, pictures and help clips.
manifest.webmanifest
What lets Chrome and Edge install the page as an app.
requirements.txt
The list of Python add-ons the launcher installs: cadquery-ocp, trimesh and numpy.
tests
The self-tests. See Self-test.
docs, README.md, CHANGELOG.md
Screenshots, the project’s description, and the list of changes in every version.

Do not open index.html by double-clicking it. The page then says it needs a local server. Always start with the launcher.
